arm.hint: Record a take on every lock (Enter takes one now)
arm.warmup: Not recording: play freely, nothing is saved. Press to start recording.

error.takeNotFound: That take is no longer in the pass.
error.unexpected: The operation failed. See the log for details.

report.formatHint: PDF is the card as one A4 page, laid out the way it prints. HTML is the same sheet as a web page. CSV is the table for a spreadsheet.
report.notesHint: Printed under the table. What was done, or what still needs doing.
report.title: Tuning card

table.deleteHint: Permanently remove this reading. Play and record the note again to replace it.
table.editHint: Click or press Enter to edit the value
table.empty: Start recording, then play notes to save readings.
table.graphHint: Compare each reed with its target. Click a column to select its row; click again to select the next register.
table.label: Recorded tuning
table.manualHint: A value in this row was typed, not heard.
table.unitHint: Reed deviations use the unit selected in Settings. Beats use hertz or the deviation unit, as selected in the toolbar.
